question: What final offering fulfills all desires when performed with the root mantra?
premises: A full final offering is made.
It is performed with the root mantra and fulfills all desires.
inference: Having made the full offering with the root mantra, one performs the oblation that fulfills all desires.
uncertainties: The form pūrṇānda/tvā is unusual and may reflect a textual or sandhi issue.
plain_english: Having made the full offering with the root mantra, the oblation that fulfills all desires.
